notes.title: Thursday update - Cutscene Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Hey 1Screeners! (As suggested by DarkwingedThumper) Happy Saturday. Update notes

So my kid has been watching these youtube videos where this guy makes incredibly elaborate mazes for their pet hamster. I was watching this one which includes a cardboard hospital when I realized, oh my god I am basically this person and you are my hamster. 

[previewyoutube=Hu3PijikTwo;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyway (my cute little hamster) here is what I have made for you with my latest update:
[list]
[*] An intro cutscene. It shows how the first 1 Screen Platformer story connects to this game. If you haven’t played 1SP here it is https://store.steampowered.com/app/791180/1_Screen_Platformer/
[*] Run timer doesn’t actually start until you move first. So at the start of the game you can just crack your knuckles, stretch your neck, wiggle your fingers in preparation. Then the nanosecond you push the dpad or one of the face button, boom the timer starts. (Thanks to Oreo 321 for their continued feedback on timer)
[*] There was a case of timer “drift” if you kept playing multiple rounds your timer would actual start a few seconds later. That is fixed now.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could actually cheat and jump ahead to the last checkpoint and then beat the game in under 2 minutes. Thanks for the Fix ARM2571. Sorry I had to delete your time.
[*] On the main menu I made the round score bigger A, B, C, D, S. No longer is it a tiny weird font running into the label. Now it should stand out more like the effort you put into it.
[*] Added a 1-way platform in the first room with a little tooltip that says push down. This is to teach you can push down to fall through. This was from feedback from a Discord user who said they didn't know you can do that. So I built this as a teaching mechanism. Hope you knew you could push down.
[*] Fixed the laser bouncy pad area on the far right of the ship. I want it to have a better “rhythm” to it. I am pretty sure I am done tinkering with that area now. Good luck
[/list]

Finally, and most importantly, I added the people who gave great feedback to the Credits. I really appreciate your input. You can see the special thanks list under Settings > Credits

If you want to give input on the game head over to the 1SP Discord and join in the conversation. We also discuss skip strategies there to improve your time. Some great ones have already been found. 

[url=https://discord.gg/ny5jRxh]Head over to the official 1SPP discord here.
[/url]


Extra side note. I really try and get these to you every Thursday but I was troubleshooting this NASTY arrays bug regarding the checkpoints and I couldn't upload a broken build. So it took me a couple days to fix it. Next update will be uploaded on Thursday August 6th! 

Best speedruns I saw this week:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1N2d8YNPcao
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=isEmG6d_R9o&

notes.title: Thursday update - head bangers ball
notes.notes:
Hey One Screeners! (Sorry I am just trying out nicknames for you, is 1SPers better?) Let me know

Anyway I just posted an update for 1 Screen Platformer Prologue that is going to make life a LOT better for you. When jumping in tight quarters it will feel much more natural. 

Basically when you jump up and are just a few pixels away from the edge I will actually nudge you to the side so you can make it up instead of hitting your head on the block. Check it out here, you see how Nadia slides around that block. It is going to make things feel so much better. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IsnRFaM.gif[/img]

Here are the other changes
[list]
[*] Reduced respawn time by 1/4 a second. I hope your run times improve by more than that.
[*] Selecting a checkpoint will now allow the main character to fall back down to the ground.
[*] Barrels go back to their starting point if you die, and they flow in a more natural path when you jump back in them. They don't just turn around and go backwards. 
[*] Fixed the lasers so they are now centered and not slightly leaking out the side of the gun. Also a little particle effect because lasers need particle effects.
[*] Filled in the spaceship background, there were a couple places you could see the stars.
[*] Added a special thanks section for all the great folks who beta tested my game pre release.
[*] Moved the boxes at the top of the warehouse area over by 1. Nobody asked for that, that is just me. Sometimes you have to do things for yourself. 
[*] Fixed the layout for the checkpoints. They will now always appear behind you instead of mixmash of some being in front and some behind. 
[*] Fixed the timer so it also is always in front of everything.
[/list]

Thats all for this week. I will talk to you again next Thursday when I have more changes. 

Keep on playing. If you want to chat about speedrunning tricks or trying to figure out how String Cheese got a 5 minute run...

[url=https://discord.gg/ny5jRxh]Head over to the official 1SPP discord here.
[/url]
